summary: Comprehensive product, UX, and technical architectural plan to transform LabourHub.pk into Pakistan's premier on-demand task and skill marketplace, featuring dual-persona switching (Worker Chahiye vs Kaam Chahiye), nationwide city hubs and category grids, live bidding feed with PKR budgets, multi-step CNIC + SMS OTP identity verification, Pro membership subscription with 0% commission, and an exportable WordPress execution architecture blueprint.
